time_note: BSD syslog timestamps carry no year/TZ; both sides emit ts=None and compare wall-clock date/time fields instead
field_contract: date='MMM DD' with zero-padded day (raw 'Nov  7' / 'Nov 07' -> 'Nov 07'); time=verbatim HH:MM:SS; host required (no-host variant = documented parser limitation); process has no spaces/colons/brackets, pid is int or explicit None when absent (None != empty, §3.3); message verbatim after the first ': ' separator; continuation lines without a timestamp header are skipped
